title: Kadai Analytics
desc: Retail intelligence platform digitising bill-based workflows through OCR, analytics, and AI-assisted operational tooling for small and mid-scale store operations.

title: FlowForge
desc: VS Code extension that visually composes Python workflows — maps function-level logic into executable DAG-style execution graphs with a drag-and-drop interface.

title: pyflow-engine
desc: Lightweight DAG execution engine for dependency-aware Python task orchestration. Built for clean asyncio-first runtime control and reusable workflow foundations.

title: Document Intelligence API
desc: Query documents in English or Tamil with cited answers, confidence scoring, and retrieval workflows. Multi-lingual RAG pipeline deployed on AKS with a Next.js front-end.

title: schema-shield
desc: Schema compatibility and transfer safety utility for data pipelines. Classifies changes as SAFE/WARNING/BREAKING. Supports Databricks, Spark, and PostgreSQL.

title: AutoML Pipeline Kit
desc: Custom AutoML pipeline framework integrating XGBoost, LightGBM, and Gradient Boosting with Airflow DAG orchestration.
